        nc -z -w 3 localhost "${port}" &> /dev/null

        return 1
    fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# healthcheck.sh - Check if services are running on expected ports
#
# Checks:
#   - Port 3000 (typically frontend/app server)
#   - Port 8080 (typically backend/API server)
#
# Exit codes:
#   0 - All services are healthy
#   1 - One or more services are unhealthy

set -euo pipefail

# Configuration
PORTS=(3000 8080)
HOST="${HEALTH_CHECK_HOST:-localhost}"
TIMEOUT="${HEALTH_CHECK_TIMEOUT:-5}"

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[0;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Track overall status
overall_status=0

# Print a separator line
separator() {
    echo "─────────────────────────────────────────────"
}

# Check if a port is responding
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2

    if command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
        # Use curl if available
        if curl -sf --max-time "$TIMEOUT" "http://${HOST}:${port}/" &> /dev/null; then
            return 0
        fi
    fi

    if command -v nc &> /dev/null; then
        # Fall back to netcat
        if nc -z -w "$TIMEOUT" "$HOST" "$port" &> /dev/null; then
            return 0
        fi
    elif bash -c "echo >/dev/tcp/${HOST}/${port}" 2>/dev/null; then
        # Fall back to bash built-in /dev/tcp
        return 0
    fi

    return 1
}

# Map ports to friendly service names
get_service_name() {
    local port=$1
    case $port in
        3000) echo "Frontend/App Server" ;;
        8080) echo "Backend/API Server" ;;
        *)    echo "Service" ;;
    esac
}

# Main health check
echo ""
echo "╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════╗"
echo "║         SERVICE HEALTH CHECK REPORT           ║"
echo "╠═══════════════════════════════════════════════╣"
printf "║  Host: %-39s ║\n" "$HOST"
printf "║  Time: %-39s ║\n" "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
echo "╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════╝"
echo ""

separator
printf "%-25s %-10s %s\n" "SERVICE" "PORT" "STATUS"
separator

for port in "${PORTS[@]}"; do
    service_name=$(get_service_name "$port")

    if check_port "$port" "$service_name"; then
        status="${GREEN}● HEALTHY${NC}"
    else
        status="${RED}● DOWN${NC}"
        overall_status=1
    fi

    printf "%-25s %-10s $(echo -e "$status")\n" "$service_name" "$port"
done

separator
echo ""

# Summary
if [ $overall_status -eq 0 ]; then
    echo -e "${GREEN}✔ All services are running and healthy.${NC}"
else
    echo -e "${RED}✘ One or more services are not responding.${NC}"
    echo -e "${YELLOW}  Please check the logs and restart any failed services.${NC}"
fi

echo ""
exit $overall_status
